correctness.rationale: For any integer n>=3, Euclidean within-layer and cross-layer squared chord distances are exact sine-square formulas. Maximization is exhaustive: odd width has cross-layer dominance; even width compares 4R^2 with h^2+4R^2 cos^2(pi*t/n), tying precisely at h=2R sin(pi*t/n). The endpoint degeneracies produce exactly one 2n-cycle, and the even simultaneous maximum produces either n/2 disjoint 4-cycles or one Möbius ladder. The terminal flag Rips complex is simplicially the diameter-graph independence complex. Independence-complex joins and the cited Kozlov and Agarwal-Basak homotopy theorems establish the entire infinite-parameter classification, including the boundary cases. The standalone checker independently matches 672 geometric diameter graphs and performs 54 direct mod-two reduced-homology calculations for n=3..8; finite tests corroborate but do not replace the proof. The Möbius-ladder homotopy branch is credited to the published 2026 theorem.

originality.rationale: The complete twist-height terminal-stage phase diagram, including the generic and exactly critical height/twist transitions, is not implied by the inspected Platonic-solids Rips theorem, the published graph-only Möbius-ladder independence theorem, graph-metric ladder results, or the previously characterized fixed uniform antiprism and rectangular-box slices. The last two are special cases and are not represented as original here. Indexed mathematical-record and literature searches disclosed no geometrically stronger double-polygon classification; unindexed work remains a risk.

value.rationale: A natural continuous geometric deformation of two congruent regular polygon layers has a complete, all-width terminal topological phase diagram. The exact equality h=2R sin(pi*t/n) detects a dimension collapse on a codimension-one locus and a threefold sphere multiplicity at an isolated even-width endpoint; integer residues mod 3 and mod 4 govern the topology. The four forbidden-diameter graphs are geometrically and topologically distinct, including an unexpected Möbius-ladder boundary. This gives a motivated structural invariant of the full 2-parameter family, not an arbitrary finite census or a renamed special case; no downstream theorem beyond the precise classification is claimed.
